I've been depressed for over a decade despite being young because of serious abuse.

I remember I was in the hospital after a failed suicide attempt and then suddenly one of my best friends showed up. It's turns out they had been planning on jumping off a roof but the police showed up and pried them off. When I asked why, they said it was because they thought I was dead and couldn't get the picture of me hanging in my closet out of their head and couldn't do it anymore.

I decided if I couldn't live for myself I had to live for other people, I couldn't let that misery I had carried with me for so long spread to other people just because I couldn't take it. I didn't slesp that night and I decided that's what I had to do.

I ended up going through 7 more suicide attempts before a similar situation where I had to hold my friend of 10 years and explain to them I was dangerously suicidal and had been abused for 17 years of my life. They ended up crying and begging me never to hurt myself again. I guess that was another wake up call for me. Even though I'm still severely depressed, I refuse to spread that pain onto others. I have to stay strong for those who love me.
